# Data247

Data247 is a simple, and secure on-demand data platform that provides businesses with a wide-range of data lookup services.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/data247/.

## Actions

- **Add Phone to Do-Not-Call List**: Add phone numbers to your internal do-not-call (DNC) list.
- **Append Email by Name and Address** (read-only): Find email addresses associated with name and postal address.
- **Append Name (CNAM Lookup)** (read-only): Get CNAM (Caller Name Delivery) data for a phone number.
- **Append Phone to Contact** (read-only): Append phone numbers to contact records using name and address.
- **Append Property Data** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive property data including home stats, ownership information, financials and foreclosure data.
- **Append Reverse Email Lookup** (read-only): Perform reverse email lookup and retrieve contact information.
- **Append Reverse Phone Lookup** (read-only): Perform reverse phone lookup and retrieve name and address information.
- **Check Account Balance** (read-only): Check Data247 account balance and remaining credits.
- **Check Phone Number Against DNC Lists** (read-only): Check if a phone number exists in Federal or internal Do-Not-Call list.
- **Check Phone Number for Fraud/SPAM** (read-only): Check if a phone number is on SPAM callers list.
- **Locate IP Address - Get Geolocation Data** (read-only): Get geolocation data for IPv4 addresses including city, state, country, and coordinates.
- **Verify Email Address** (read-only): Verify email address format and mailbox existence.
- **Verify Phone Number Active Status** (read-only): Verify if a phone number is in-service and accepts inbound calls.
- **Verify USA Postal Address** (read-only): Verify and correct USA postal addresses to USPS standards.
- **Verify User Identity Trust Score** (read-only): Verify user signup legitimacy and detect account creation fraud.
- **Append Gender by First Name** (read-only): Determine a person's probable gender based on their first (given) name.
- **Append Reverse Zipcode Lookup** (read-only): Get formatted address components from a zipcode.
- **Append ZIP+4 to Address** (read-only): Append ZIP+4 postal codes to addresses and standardize address information.
- **Get Carrier and Gateway Info (Text@ Service)** (read-only): Get carrier information, wireless status, and email-to-SMS/MMS gateway addresses for USA and Canadian phone numbers using the Text@ service.
- **Get Carrier Type for Phone Number** (read-only): Determine carrier type for USA and Canadian phone numbers.
- **Get USA Carrier and SMS/MMS Gateway Info** (read-only): Get carrier information, wireless status, and SMS/MMS gateway addresses for USA phone numbers.
- **Remove Phone from Do-Not-Call List**: Remove phone numbers from your internal do-not-call (DNC) list.
